**testrail__add_run**

Create a new test run in the specified project.

A run defines the set of test cases to execute.  Set include_all=True to
include every case in the suite, or provide a case_ids list to select
specific cases.  suite_id is required for multi-suite projects.

Pass dynamic_filters to select cases by matching rules instead of a fixed
list.  Discover the filterable fields with get_dynamic_filter_fields and
reference each system_name prefixed with cases:.  The server applies
dynamic_filters only when include_all is false or absent and case_ids is
empty or absent, otherwise it ignores them.

**xray__get_test_execution**

Return a single Xray Test Execution by its Jira issue id.

A Test Execution is a schedulable task that runs one or more Tests for a version.

Available fields on TestExecution:
  issueId: String       Jira issue id of the Test Execution
  projectId: String     Jira project id of the Test Execution
  testEnvironments: [String]   Test Environments of the Test Execution
  tests(issueIds: [String], limit: Int!, start: Int): TestResults   linked Tests
  testPlans(issueIds: [String], limit: Int!, start: Int): TestPlanResults   linked Test Plans
  testRuns(limit: Int!, start: Int): TestRunResults   Test Runs for the Test Execution
  history(limit: Int!, start: Int): XrayHistoryResults   Xray history entries for the Test Execution
  jira(fields: [String]): JSON   extra Jira fields, e.g. jira(fields: ["key", "summary"])
  lastModified: String  date the Test Execution was last modified
Each *Results type named above (TestResults, TestPlanResults, TestRunResults,
XrayHistoryResults) has its own fields. Call describe_type with a type name to
read its fields before selecting into it.
Example: 'issueId projectId testEnvironments jira(fields: ["key", "summary"])'

```json
{
  "input_schema": {
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "properties": {
      "fields": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "issue_id": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "type": "null"
          }
        ],
        "default": null
      }
    },
    "required": [
      "fields"
    ],
    "type": "object"
  },
  "score": 3.042844295501709
}
```

**xray__get_datasets**

Return the Xray Datasets matching the given filters.

A Dataset must pass every filter given. A filter passes if any of its values match.
Supply at least one filter to receive Datasets.

This tool returns a list of Dataset, whose selectable fields are documented on
get_dataset. Unlike the other list tools it is not paged, so it takes no limit
or start argument.
Example: 'id testIssueId parameters { name type } rows { order Values }'

  jira(fields: [String]): JSON   extra Jira fields, e.g. jira(fields: ["key", "summary"])

**xray__get_datasets**

Return the Xray Datasets matching the given filters.

A Dataset must pass every filter given. A filter passes if any of its values match.
